body: # Mindustry³ — 3D & FPV for Mindustry (!Before you'll read the repository i want to notice you that the entire project is 99% vibe-coded!) Mindustry³ started with a simple idea: what if I could fly a unit in Mindustry from a first-person perspective, with controls inspired by Liftoff? What began as an FPV flight experiment gradually became a much larger project: a three-dimensional Mindustry experience with XYZ movement, multi-floor factories, volumetric construction, procedural landscapes and modeled industrial machinery. **Current candidate:** Alpha 2.0.0 RC1 · **Mod version:** 0.19.0 · **Target game:** Mindustry 160.7. This is my experimental, fan-made mod, not an official Mindustry release. ## What is Mindustry³? I'm developing Mindustry³ to explore familiar factories, units and battles from a different perspective. You can fly in first person, switch to a third-person camera, or return to the original 2D view. Build Mode brings construction into the same 3D world, including supported upper floors and multi-floor structures. The project builds on Mindustry's existing systems. Construction still needs resources and valid support, weapons still use real combat rules, and multiplayer keeps the server authoritative. ## Screenshots and gameplay media ## Main features - **FPV flight and unit control:** Acro and Stabilized flight, first-person and third-person cameras, possession of eligible units and turrets, and native group commands. - **XYZ construction:** build on Z0 and supported elevated floors, pause and resume construction, and choose which unfinished blueprint to complete first. - **Volumetric selection and copying:** select an X/Y area and Z range, preview a multi-floor structure, rotate it and queue construction with normal costs and validation. - **Procedural 3D machinery:** dedicated models and operating animations across drills, factories, logistics, power, liquids, support blocks, cores and unit production. Logic displays show real processor-generated graphics. - **Layered infrastructure:** supported item, liquid and power connections between construction floors, with structural support and collapse rules. - **Terrain and scenery:** natural surface relief, 3D ore deposits, liquids, vegetation, configurable biome backgrounds and cosmic scenery. Mountains have Smooth, Blocky and Hybrid visual styles. - **Campaign and multiplayer integration:** campaign save/load support, multiplayer diagnostics, optimized pose snapshots and local movement presentation prediction. Multiplayer remains experimental. Prediction does not grant clients authority over damage, resource spending or construction. Mountain styles change presentation, not physical terrain heights; they do not add voxel climbing or digging. ## Installation Install **Mindustry 160.7** separately and back up your saves before trying an Alpha. Use only **one enabled copy** of Mindustry³: don't combine an imported JAR with a Workshop subscription. You do not need a separate Java installation, a JDK, Python, PowerShell or developer files to play. Use the runtime included with the game. ### GitHub Releases 1. Open [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/RostiSllAVE/Mindustry3D/releases) and download the mod JAR for the available release you want to install. RC1's filename is `mindustry-fpv-0.19.0.jar`. 2. In Mindustry, open **Mods → Import Mod → Import File** and select the JAR. 3. Accept replacement of an older Mindustry³ installation, then restart the game normally. 4. Start a map or save and press **F5**. Press **Tab** to enter Build Mode. For a convenience ZIP, extract it first and import the JAR inside. The corresponding-source ZIP and Workshop upload ZIP are not player import packages. Published packages include SHA-256 checksums so you can verify your download. ### Steam Workshop Subscribe to the project's Workshop item, wait for the download to finish, then restart Mindustry and check that the mod is enabled. Remove or disable an imported copy before using the subscribed version. ### Mindustry Mod Browser Open **Mods → Mod Browser**, find Mindustry³ / FPV, install it and restart the game. **Fullscreen is strongly recommended.** I observed severe stalls in windowed mode on my Windows PC; fullscreen removed them in that test. This is a practical workaround, not a claim that every PC behaves the same way. ## Controls These are the defaults. Remappable bindings in the game's Controls and FPV settings take precedence; the Build panel explains contextual selection and paste tools. | Control | Action | | --- | --- | | F5 | Switch between original 2D and FPV 3D | | Tab | Enter/leave Build Mode; release the cursor while building | | F7 | Cycle first person, front observer and rear follow views | | Alt+F7 | Toggle camera smoothing; OFF by default, saved in settings | | Alt+wheel | Adjust third-person camera distance | | F9 | Switch Acro / Stabilized flight | | W/S in Acro | Increase/decrease persistent throttle | | A/D in Acro | Yaw | | Mouse in Acro | Pitch/roll; arrow keys provide keyboard look | | WASD in Stabilized / ground control | Move relative to horizontal view direction | | Q/E in Stabilized flight | Descend/climb | | Q/E on walkers | Lower/raise stance | | LMB in flight | Fire through the controlled unit's weapon rules | | Hold RMB in FPV | Mine aimed valid ore with a capable unit | | F2 | Native boost/landing for eligible units | | F8 | Creator Flight for ground units, if permitted by the host | | F10 / native command binding | Enter unit command selection | | Shift+drag in command mode | Select friendly units for native movement/attack commands | | Ctrl+click in Build | Possess an eligible friendly unit or controllable turret | | PageUp / PageDown in Build | Choose/lock the construction floor | | F3 | Pause/resume your construction without deleting plans | | Click an unfinished blueprint | Prioritize it when no placement tool is selected | | Alt+click a blueprint | Prioritize it while keeping a selected placement tool | | Ctrl+F in Build | Use the existing single-floor schematic copy workflow | | F4 in Build | Enter 3D Selection: drag X/Y, use the wheel for the Z boundary | | Ctrl+Shift+C / Ctrl+Shift+V in 3D mode | Copy the selection / preview the session clipboard | | R / Shift+R in 3D paste | Rotate the structure by a quarter turn | | LMB in paste / RMB / Esc | Queue valid construction / cancel preview / leave the tool | Mouse capture releases in Build Mode, command selection, menus, on focus loss and when leaving FPV. If native capture is unavailable, **HOST MOUSE** is a bounded fallback: mouse movement can reach the window edge, while keyboard look remains available. ## Compatibility | Environment | Current status | | --- | --- | | Mindustry 160.7, Windows x64 standalone | Primary test environment; isolated startup, import/restart and actual OpenGL tests pass | | Full Java 17 | 214/214 automated regression programs pass | | Stock reduced Java 25.0.1 | 214/214 automated regression programs pass; startup works without a separate Java installation | | Steam on Windows | Previous Java 25 startup and mouse-capture fixes are retained | | Linux desktop | I launched an earlier build on a Linux laptop. RC1's native capture, X11/Wayland behavior and both Windows/Linux hosting directions still need manual testing | | Android | Not supported | | macOS, other game revisions and arbitrary mod combinations | Not validated release targets | **Multiplayer requires the exact same build on every peer:** matching code, resources and version, with strict payload verification. Protocol 4 alone does not make different builds compatible. The JAR and compiled Workshop folder from the same RC package share one verified identity. A dedicated server and two local clients passed a narrow production/synchronization test on one Windows PC. That does not establish cross-platform, independent internet or high-latency multiplayer compatibility. Broad Linux support is not certified by one laptop launch. ## Known limitations - **Windowed-mode performance:** fullscreen is the current workaround for the stalls observed on my Windows PC. No universal FPS improvement is claimed. - **Visual polish:** small clipping issues, approximate materials, distant LOD/background seams and incomplete custom-block coverage can remain. - **Construction and copying:** placement still respects supported floors, range, resources and structural rules. The 3D clipboard lasts only for the current session; unsupported external configurations or links may be omitted with a warning. - **Saves and campaign:** automated save/load tests use disposable data. Long campaign sessions, every sector/planet transition and all older modded saves have not been exhaustively tested. Keep backups. - **Input and multiplayer:** real mouse/focus behavior, Linux compositor support and two-computer hosting in both directions still need manual RC testing. Automated fixtures cannot replace those checks. For a useful bug report, include the game/mod version, operating system, installation method and relevant log excerpt. Remove personal paths, IP addresses, account details and tokens before sharing logs. ## Building from source This section is for development; none of these tools are required to install the mod. Use Python 3, a complete JDK 17 and a separately installed official standalone Mindustry 160.7. Supply `lib/jna-5.19.1.jar`; its required SHA-256 and source/license links are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). The build checks that dependency and bundles its redistributable contents with the notices. The host game remains compile-only and is not redistributed. Set `FPV_MINDUSTRY` to the standalone game directory and `FPV_JDK` to the JDK directory, or configure the ignored `local/dev-runtime.json` file. From the repository root: ```text python tools/build.py ``` The build refuses to overwrite an existing versioned JAR. To reproduce the validated RC1 binary, use its matching corresponding-source archive, which records release checkpoint `0197871`. Later documentation-only updates do not replace that archive or the validated release packages. To run the compiled regressions against the selected stock Java 25 runtime: ```text python tools/test-diagnostic-runtime.py --build build --jar dist/mindustry-fpv-0.19.0.jar --java bundled25 --run rc-stock25 ``` To launch a separate disposable standalone profile: ```text python tools/launch-standalone.py --run rc-preview --jar dist/mindustry-fpv-0.19.0.jar --interactive ``` Choose a new `--run` name for each test. The original standalone installation is kept as a clean reference; test profiles, logs, recordings, SDKs and build outputs are ignored. The normal standalone development workflow does not require Steam. See the [distribution checklist](docs/alpha-v2/A2-18-DISTRIBUTION-CHECKLIST.md) for packaging and source-verification details. ## License and acknowledgments Mindustry³ is licensed under **GPL-3.0-only**. See [LICENSE](LICENSE), [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and the included [dependency notices](licenses/). Thanks to **Anuken and the Mindustry/Arc contributors** for the game and its open-source foundations. Vanilla textures and the game runtime come from the separately installed Mindustry host. JNA/libffi license notices are retained in the distribution. Use the matching corresponding-source archive and checksum manifest for each binary; the source ZIP is not an installable mod. **Liftoff: FPV Drone Racing** inspired the initial control idea. No Liftoff code or assets are included, and it is not required to play. I create and maintain this project, with Codex assisting implementation and testing.

![Logo](icon.png)
# Mindustry PackLoader
![Mindustry](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mindustry-v160+-EE82EE?style=for-the-badge)
[![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/annguyen2k8/MindustryPackLoader?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&color=32CD32)](https://github.com/annguyen2k8/MindustryPackLoader/releases/latest)
[![Total Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/annguyen2k8/MindustryPackLoader/total?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&color=2E7D32)](https://github.com/annguyen2k8/MindustryPackLoader/releases)

A Mindustry Java mod for bulk importing maps (`.msav`) and schematics (`.msch`) directly from ZIP archives or folders on Android and Desktop.


## Features

- **Bulk Import:** Import dozens of maps and schematics from `.zip` packs or folders in one operation.
- **Smart Conflict Handling:** Choose how to resolve duplicate files:
  - **Skip:** Keep existing game files intact.
  - **Overwrite:** Replace existing files with imported versions.
  - **Rename:** Automatically append numbers (`_1`, `_2`) to keep both.
- **Instant Hot-Reload:** Automatically reloads game maps and schematics immediately without restarting Mindustry.
- **Safe & Validated:** Built-in Zip Slip protection, file header verification for `.msch` and `.msav` streams, and atomic writes via temporary files.
- **Mobile-Optimized:** Designed for Android with touch-friendly controls, multi-selection checkboxes, search filtering, and System File Picker (SAF) support.
- **Seamless In-Game Integration:** Direct action buttons located on the **Main Menu**, **Schematics**, **Custom Game**, and **Map Editor** screens.


## Installation

1. Download the latest `MindustryPackLoader.jar` from Releases (or build locally).
2. Launch Mindustry, navigate to **Mods** > **Import Mod** > **Import from File**.
3. Select `MindustryPackLoader.jar` and enable the mod.


## Usage

### Opening PackLoader
- **Main Menu:** Click the **Pack Loader** button to open the loader dialog.
- **Schematics / Maps Menus:** Click **Import .zip** or **Scan Folder** directly inside the respective dialogs.

### Import Workflow
1. **Choose Source:** Select a `.zip` pack via the file picker or browse a device folder.
2. **Review & Select:** Check the items you want to import, or use **Select All** / **Deselect All**.
3. **Select Conflict Policy:** Pick **Skip**, **Overwrite**, or **Rename**.
4. **Import:** Tap **Import Selected**. Review the import summary and tap to open your updated Schematics or Maps library.


## Building & Testing

### Requirements
- **JDK 17**
- **Android SDK** (API 21+, `d8` in `PATH` and `ANDROID_HOME` configured for Android builds)
- Target: **Mindustry v160+**

### Commands

- **Run Unit Tests (45 tests):**
  ```bash
  ./gradlew test
  ```
- **Build Desktop Mod (`MindustryPackLoaderDesktop.jar`):**
  ```bash
  ./gradlew jar
  ```
  Output: `build/libs/MindustryPackLoaderDesktop.jar`

- **Build Universal Mod with Android Support (`classes.dex`):**
  ```bash
  ./gradlew deploy
  ```
  Output: `build/libs/MindustryPackLoader.jar`

- **Verify Localization & JAR Packaging:**
  ```bash
  ./gradlew verifyJar
  ```

body: # Implosion Explore a new planet: **europa**, an underwater world infested by mechanical and natural invaders. Forget the classic gameplay of Erekir and Serpulo as you try to eradicate the enemy presence of the abyss team while harnessing the power of the enervine, an invasive specie that was possibly genetically modified in an abandoned facility that you can explore. Plentiful new game mechanics are introduced in a fully-fledged campaign that can be completed with 3 (offense) + 1 (mining) unit trees each having unique characteristics. # Building ## Building for Desktop Testing 1. Install JDK **17**. 2. Run `gradlew jar` [1]. 3. Your mod jar will be in the `build/libs` directory. **Only use this version for testing on desktop. It will not work with Android.** To build an Android-compatible version, you need the Android SDK. You can either let Github Actions handle this, or set it up yourself. See steps below. ## Building Locally Building locally takes more time to set up, but shouldn't be a problem if you've done Android development before. 1. Download the Android SDK, unzip it and set the `ANDROID_HOME` environment variable to its location. 2. Make sure you have API level 30 installed, as well as any recent version of build tools (e.g. 30.0.1) 3. Add a build-tools folder to your PATH. For example, if you have `30.0.1` installed, that would be `$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/30.0.1`. 4. Run `gradlew deploy`. If you did everything correctlly, this will create a jar file in the `build/libs` directory that can be run on both Android and desktop. # Socials you can see our [trello](https://trello.com/invite/b/lZ9qBqhg/ATTI6391bef7ad11ff64bfad07c7489ed8424C563CD3/implosion) or contact us on discord: https://discord.gg/aHwn7Mrwge

Uma coletânea de Mods Erekir em um só Mod.

Este complemento para o Mindustry foi projetado para o planeta Erekir, oferecendo uma coletânea exclusiva de [3] Mods atualmente. Embora aparente ser um Modpack, ajustes, adições e exclusões de arquivos foram necessários para garantir a compatibilidade entre os mods. A melhor forma para contribuir com Erekir Mods é contribuir com os desenvolvedores originais dos mods. Fazendo isso, estarão ajudando a atualizar e melhorar seus mods, o que desencadeará um efeito no qual serei obrigado a atualizar este Mod dos Mods com a atualização feita pelo criador original.

## ISSUES E PULL REQUEST

Antes de propor melhorias ao projeto, visite os mods originais. Erekir Mods é como uma árvore em crescimento, e somente com a nutrição adequada das raízes (os Mods Originais), esta árvore dará frutos.

name: Mindustry-SpeedControl
author: Adham084
description:
Speeds up or slows down Mindustry.
Credits to sk7725 for making TimeControl-7.

[scarlet]Disclaimer: not intended for multiplayer use![]
body:
# Speed Control

A simple client-side utility mod for Mindustry that allows you to speed up or slow down the game in real time.

## Useful for

- Sandbox testing.
- Map building.
- Unit behavior testing.
- Logic debugging.
- Time-sensitive builds.
- Watching large battles faster.

## Features

- Speed up the game up to x256
- Slow down the game to x1/256
- Smooth slider interface
- Quick reset button
- Compact HUD integration
- Mobile and desktop support

## Usage

Click the speed control button on the left side of the HUD.

### Controls

- Slider — Adjust game speed.
- Reset Button — Return to normal speed (x1).
- Toggle Button — Show or hide the speed controls.

### Speed Values

The slider uses powers of two:

Slider| Speed
-8| x1/256
-7| x1/128
-6| x1/64
-5| x1/32
-4| x1/16
-3| x1/8
-2| x1/4
-1| x1/2
0| x1
1| x2
2| x4
3| x8
4| x16
5| x32
6| x64
7| x128
8| x256

## Compatibility

- Client-side only
- Does not modify saves
- Does not require server support

## Installation

### From GitHub

1. Download the latest release or clone this repository.
2. Place the mod folder inside your Mindustry "mods" directory.
3. Launch Mindustry and enable the mod.

### Mods Directory

#### Windows

```
%AppData%\Mindustry\mods
```

#### Linux

```
~/.local/share/Mindustry/mods
```

#### Android

```
Android/data/io.anuke.mindustry/files/mods
```

## Disclaimer

This mod changes the local game speed by overriding Mindustry's delta time provider. Results may vary at extremely high speed multipliers depending on hardware performance and map complexity.

This mod is *NOT* multiplayer compatible, don't use on servers.

Due to certain game implementation details, liquids and flying units may misbehave on higher speeds, use with caution.

## Acknowledgement

Credits for sk7725 for making Time Control.

name: ModustryBridge
author: Roxxedo
description: Install mods from Modustry Website
body:
Modustry Bridge

A local bridge between Modustry and Mindustry, allowing the website to communicate with the game and install mods more easily.

Modustry Website · Report Bug · Request Feature

## About **Modustry Bridge** is a Mindustry mod that runs a small local HTTP server inside the game. Its purpose is to connect the **Modustry website** with the local Mindustry client, making it possible for the website to request actions such as checking if the bridge is running, pairing with the game session, listing installed mods, and installing selected mods directly into Mindustry. The bridge is designed to work locally and only accept controlled requests from trusted origins. ## Features - Local HTTP server running inside Mindustry - Communication between Modustry and the game client - Session-based pairing flow - Install mods from the Modustry website - Install one or multiple mods through bridge requests - List installed mods - Health check endpoint - Basic CORS handling for browser requests - Safer workflow using a temporary pairing code ## How It Works Modustry Bridge starts together with Mindustry and opens a local HTTP server. The Modustry website can then send requests to the bridge, usually through `localhost`, to perform supported actions. A simplified workflow looks like this: 1. Mindustry starts with Modustry Bridge installed. 2. The bridge starts a local HTTP server. 3. The website checks if the bridge is available. 4. The user pairs the website with the current game session. 5. After pairing, the website can request supported actions, such as installing mods. ## Pairing Flow For security and user control, Modustry Bridge uses a temporary pairing flow. When the game starts, the bridge generates a session pairing code. The website must provide the correct code before being allowed to perform protected actions. The intended flow is: 1. The bridge generates a pairing code for the current session. 2. The website asks the user to pair with the bridge. 3. The user confirms that the code shown on the website matches the code shown in-game. 4. After confirmation, the website is considered paired for that session. 5. When the game restarts, a new code is generated. This avoids silently allowing any website to control the bridge without user confirmation. --- ## API Endpoints > The exact endpoint names may change as the project evolves. ### Health Check Checks if Modustry Bridge is running. ```http GET /health ``` Example response: ```json { "status": "running", } ``` --- ### Pair Request Request pairing with the current bridge session. ```http GET /pair/request ``` Example response: ```json { "pairCode": "123456" } ``` --- ### Pair Confirm Confirm pairing with the current bridge session. ```http GET /pair/confirm ``` Example request: ```json { "pairCode": "123456" } ``` --- ### List Installed Mods Returns the mods currently installed in Mindustry. ```http GET /mods/installed ``` Example response: ```json [ { "class": "br.com.roxcom.modustrybridge.services.ModsService$ModInfo", "id": "modustrybridge", "name": "Modustry Bridge", "author": "Roxxedo", "description": "Install mods from Modustry Website", "version": "0.1", "minGameVersion": "154", "enabled": true, "state": "enabled", "fileName": "ModustryBrideg.zip", "filePath": "/home/roxxedo/.local/share/Mindustry/mods/ModustryBridge.zip", "dependencies": [], "softDependencies": [], "missingDependencies": [], "missingSoftDependencies": [] } ] ``` --- ### Install a Mod Installs a single mod from a repository. ```http POST /mods/install ``` Example request: ```json { "id": "modustrybridge" } ``` Example response: ```json { "installed": true, } ``` --- ## CORS Because the bridge is accessed from a browser, it needs to handle CORS requests properly. The bridge should: - Allow only trusted Modustry origins - Respond to `OPTIONS` preflight requests - Allow the required HTTP methods - Allow the required request headers - Avoid exposing unsafe local actions to arbitrary websites Example allowed methods: ```http GET, POST, OPTIONS ``` Example allowed headers: ```http Content-Type, X-Modustry-Pair-Code ``` --- ## Security Notes Modustry Bridge runs locally and can trigger actions inside the user's Mindustry installation. Because of that, security should be treated carefully. Recommended behavior: - Require pairing before protected actions - Generate a new pairing code every game session - Do not accept install requests before pairing - Restrict CORS to trusted origins - Validate all incoming request bodies - Never execute arbitrary code from requests - Only install mods from supported and validated sources --- ## Development ### Requirements - Java - Mindustry - Arc / Mindustry modding environment - Gradle ### Building Clone the repository: ```sh git clone https://github.com/roxcom-br/modustry-bridge.git ``` Enter the project folder: ```sh cd modustry-bridge ``` Build the mod: ```sh ./gradlew jar ``` The generated mod file should be available in the build output directory. --- ## Project Structure A possible structure for the bridge is: ```txt src/ └── main/ └── java/ └── br/com/roxcom/modustrybridge/ ├── ModustryBridge.java ├── dialogs/ │ ├── ModInstalledDialog.java │ ├── ModInstallErrorDialog.java │ ├── RequestPairingDialog.java │ ├── ServerErrorDialog.java │ └── WrongPairCodeDialog.java ├── handlers/ │ ├── BaseHandler.java │ ├── HealthHandler.java │ ├── InstalledModsHandler.java │ ├── InstallModHandler.java │ ├── PairConfirmHandler.java │ └── PairRequestHandler.java └── services/ ├── ModsService.java └── PairingService.java ``` --- ## Roadmap - [ ] Improve pairing confirmation flow - [ ] Add better error responses - [ ] Add batch mod installation - [ ] Add installation progress feedback - [ ] Improve validation for incoming requests - [ ] Add more detailed installed mod metadata - [ ] Add automatic reload or restart guidance after installing mods - [ ] Improve website integration --- ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. To contribute: 1. Fork the repository 2. Create a new branch ```sh git checkout -b feature/my-feature ``` 3. Commit your changes ```sh git commit -m "feat: add my feature" ``` 4. Push to your branch ```sh git push origin feature/my-feature ``` 5. Open a Pull Request --- ## License Distributed under the **GNU General Public License v3.0**. See `LICENSE` for more information. --- ## Related Projects - [Modustry](https://github.com/roxcom-br/modustry) — Website for browsing Mindustry mods and texture packs - [Mindustry](https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry) — The game this project integrates with ---

name: force-landscape
author: Vkazee
description: Added a manual option in Settings to force landscape mode on Android/iOS, without having to change the phone's rotation settings.
body:
# Force Landscape Toggle

A small mod for Mindustry (Android/iOS) that adds a **manual** option to the Settings menu to force landscape mode, without needing to change your phone's screen rotation settings.

## Why this mod exists
The official version of Mindustry already includes internal hooks for forcing landscape mode (`Platform.beginForceLandscape()` / `endForceLandscape()`). However, these hooks are only used internally (such as in the Map Editor) and are not exposed to players through the Settings menu. This mod adds a toggle to make that functionality available.

## How to use
1. Install this mod through **Mods > Import Mod** in Mindustry.
2. Open **Settings** and look for the **Force Landscape** category.
3. Enable the **Force Landscape Mode** toggle.
4. The game will automatically stay in landscape mode, even if your device is locked to portrait orientation in the system settings.

## Compatibility
- Android & iOS (uses the game's built-in `mobile` flag).
- `minGameVersion: 158`.

Mindustry ойынының толық қазақ тіліндегі аудармасы

**Kazakh Translation** — бұл [Mindustry](https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry) ойынының толық қазақ тіліндегі аударма модулі. Барлық ойын мәтіндері, блоктар, юниттер, интерфейс элементтері және логикалық нұсқаулар қазақ тіліне аударылған. ## Мазмұны - [Орнату](#орнату) - [Қалай қосу керек](#қалай-қосу-керек) - [Қалай жұмыс істейді](#қалай-жұмыс-істейді) - [Мүмкіндіктер](#мүмкіндіктер) - [Аударма статистикасы](#аударма-статистикасы) - [Аударылған бөлімдер](#аударылған-бөлімдер) - [Қолдау](#қолдау) - [Лицензия](#лицензия) ## Орнату ### Қолмен орнату 1. Модтың соңғы нұсқасын [жүктеп алыңыз](https://github.com/Xenonixq/Kazakh-Translation/releases) 2. Қалтаны `Mindustry/saves/mods/Kazakh Translation` жолына көшіріңіз 3. Ойынды іске қосыңыз 4. **Mods** мәзіріне өтіп, модты қосыңыз ### GitHub арқылы орнату 1. Ойын ішінде **Mods** → **Import Mod** → **GitHub** таңдаңыз 2. Келесі сілтемені енгізіңіз: `Xenonixq/Kazakh-Translation` ## Қалай қосу керек Мод орнатылғаннан кейін оны **Mods** мәзірінде қосыңыз. Содан кейін **Settings → Language** бөліміне өтіп, кез келген тілді таңдаңыз (ағылшын тілінен басқасының бәрі). Ойын мәтіні қазақ тілінде көрсетіледі. ## Қалай жұмыс істейді Модта 34 тілге арналған `bundle_XX.properties` файлдары бар (орыс, неміс, француз, испан, қытай, жапон және т.б.). Әрбір файл қазақ аудармасын қамтиды. Ағылшын тілі (`bundle.properties`) өзгеріссіз қалады. Ойын жүктелген кезде, `buildFiles()` әдісі әрбір тілдің бандл тізбегінен өтіп, модтың `bundles/` қалтасынан сәйкес `bundle_XX.properties` файлын тауып, оны жүктейді. Осылайша, ағылшын тілінен басқа кез келген тіл үшін қазақ мәтіні қолданылады. ## Мүмкіндіктер - ✅ **Толық аударма** — 3000+ жол мәтін аударылған - ✅ **34 тілді жабады** — ағылшын тілінен басқасының бәрі қазақша - ✅ **Барлық блоктар** — Serpulo және Erekir планеталарының барлық блоктары - ✅ **Барлық юниттер** — жер, әуе, теңіз және Erekir юниттері - ✅ **Интерфейс** — мәзірлер, батырмалар, параметрлер, байлаулар - ✅ **Логикалық нұсқаулар** — процессорларға арналған барлық нұсқаулар - ✅ **Туториалдар** — оқыту жүйесінің барлық мәтіндері - ✅ **Секторлар** — барлық сектор атаулары мен сипаттамалары - ✅ **Түс тегтері сақталған** — `[accent]`, `[scarlet]`, `[red]` және т.б. - ✅ **Белгішелер сақталған** — `:copper:`, `:lead:`, `:power:` және т.б. ## Аударма статистикасы | Категория | Жол саны | |-----------|----------| | Блоктар (Serpulo) | ~200 | | Блоктар (Erekir) | ~100 | | Юниттер (Serpulo) | ~60 | | Юниттер (Erekir) | ~30 | | Секторлар | ~200 | | Заттар мен сұйықтықтар | ~50 | | Интерфейс | ~500 | | Логикалық нұсқаулар | ~100 | | Туториалдар | ~300 | | Карталар мен миссиялар | ~200 | | Басқа | ~1200 | | **Барлығы** | **~3025** | ## Аударылған бөлімдер - **Блоктар**: өндіріс, қуат, қорғаныс, тасымалдау, сақтау, логика, құрылыс - **Юниттер**: жер, әуе, теңіз, мехтар, кемелер, танктер - **Заттар**: мыс, қорғасын, титан, торий, кремний, фазалық мата және т.б. - **Сұйықтықтар**: су, мұнай, криосұйықтық, қож, озон, сутегі және т.б. - **Интерфейс**: мәзірлер, параметрлер, статистика, жетістіктер, кеңестер - **Логика**: барлық `lst.*` нұсқаулары, `lglobal.*` айнымалылары, `lenum.*` мәндері - **Туториалдар**: оқыту жүйесінің барлық қадамдары - **Карталар**: сектор атаулары, сипаттамалары, миссиялар ## Қолдау Егер аудармадан қате тапсаңыз немесе жақсарту ұсыныстарыңыз болса: - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Xenonixq/Kazakh-Translation/issues) бетінде хабарлаңыз - Pull Request жіберіңіз ## Лицензия Бұл мод [GPL-3.0](LICENSE) лицензиясы бойынша таратылады. Бұл Mindustry ойынының ресми емес аудармасы.

name: schempack-manager
author: darkjeanne
description: Sync Mindustry schematics with GitHub, with auto push, pull/merge, and local-only filtering.
body:
# SchemPack Manager
Make your Mindustry schematic folder a GitHub-backed schempack.

## Instructions

### Requirements

- Git must be installed and available from the command line. Check with `git --version`.
- A GitHub account.
- A GitHub repository for the schempack.
- A GitHub access token that can read and write repository contents.

### Create the Repository

Create a new GitHub repository for your schempack. An empty repository is recommended for first setup.

When the mod asks for the repo link, paste one of these forms:

```text
https://github.com/username/repository.git
https://github.com/username/repository
git@github.com:username/repository.git
```

The mod stores the remote as an HTTPS GitHub repo.

### Create the Access Token

Fine-grained token:

1. Open GitHub `Settings -> Developer settings -> Personal access tokens -> Fine-grained tokens`.
2. Generate a new token for the schempack repository.
3. Set repository permission `Contents` to `Read and write`.
4. Copy the token after creating it. GitHub will not show it again.

Classic token:

1. Open GitHub `Settings -> Developer settings -> Personal access tokens -> Tokens (classic)`.
2. Generate a token with `repo` for private repositories, or `public_repo` for public repositories only.
3. Copy the token after creating it.

### Initialize In Game

1. Open Mindustry.
2. Open `Schematics`.
3. Press `SchemPack`.
4. Press `Edit Repository`.
5. Enter the repo link, GitHub username, and access token.
6. Save, then run compare or sync from the SchemPack screen.

`Force Push Local` overwrites the GitHub repo with the local schematic folder. Use it only when the local schempack is the version you want to keep.

## Releasing

The in-game mod browser needs a GitHub Release with the built jar attached. GitHub automatically adds the source code `.zip` and `.tar.gz` archives to every release.

Automatic release options:

1. Push a version tag:

```sh
git tag release_1.0
git push origin release_1.0
```

2. Or run the `Release` workflow manually from GitHub Actions and enter a tag like `release_1.0` or `v1.0.0`.

The workflow builds `build/libs/schempack-manager.jar`, creates the GitHub Release, and uploads the jar.

## Building for Desktop Testing

1. Install JDK **17**.
2. Run `gradlew jar` [1].
3. Your mod jar will be in the `build/libs` directory. **Only use this version for testing on desktop. It will not work with Android.**
To build an Android-compatible version, you need the Android SDK. You can either let Github Actions handle this, or set it up yourself. See steps below.

## Building Locally

Building locally takes more time to set up, but shouldn't be a problem if you've done Android development before.
1. Download the Android SDK, unzip it and set the `ANDROID_HOME` environment variable to its location.
2. Make sure you have API level 30 installed, as well as any recent version of build tools (e.g. 30.0.1)
3. Add a build-tools folder to your PATH. For example, if you have `30.0.1` installed, that would be `$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/30.0.1`.
4. Run `gradlew deploy`. If you did everything correctlly, this will create a jar file in the `build/libs` directory that can be run on both Android and desktop.

body:
# Better Mindustry — 更好的像素工厂

> 作者：弈秋忘忧白帽
> 版本：1.0.0
> 最低游戏版本：v158

## 概述

全面提升 Mindustry 游戏体验的综合向模组，集成了多项实用功能，所有功能均可通过 **BM 设置**（游戏设置 → BM设置）独立开启/关闭。

## 功能列表

所有功能均支持在 BM 设置中独立开关，部分功能需重启游戏生效。

### 1. 内置楷体字体

- 在游戏主界面中替换默认字体为内置楷体
- 适合中文显示，效果更美观
- 由 Java 设置 + JS 脚本联合控制，启动时注入字体文件
- 需重启游戏生效

### 2. 显示未解锁科技

- 在科技树中显示未解锁的内容（灰色图标）
- 点击不会解锁，仅作预览
- 需重启游戏生效

### 3. 游戏内时间流速控件

- 在游戏界面左下角添加时间流速控制面板
- 支持：1×、16×、32×、64× 四档速度
- 仅调整游戏运行速度，不影响单位、规则或胜负判定
- 面板可拖动
- 需重启游戏生效

### 4. 游戏内核心资源面板

- 在游戏界面左上角显示核心资源面板
- 实时显示当前核心所拥有的资源及数量
- 显示核心数量、在线玩家、采矿单位数量
- 面板可拖动
- 需重启游戏生效

### 5. 自定义加载界面 \[功能实验性测试]

- 替换原版加载界面为自定义样式
- 可选显示阶段文字、当前加载的 Mod 列表、内存用量
- 进度条动画速度可调
- 可在设置中完全关闭以使用原版加载界面

## 设置说明

所有设置位于 **游戏设置 → BM设置**（带扳手图标），目前包含以下开关：

| 设置项       | 设置键                    | 默认值 | 需重启 |
| --------- | ---------------------- | --- | --- |
| 使用内置楷体字体  | `bm-kai-font-enabled`  | 关闭  | 是   |
| 显示未解锁科技   | `bm-showlocked`        | 关闭  | 是   |
| 游戏内时间流速控件 | `bm-timeflow-enabled`  | 关闭  | 是   |
| 游戏内核心资源面板 | `bm-coreitems-enabled` | 关闭  | 是   |

> 注：由于 JS 脚本在游戏启动时一次性执行，所有依赖 JS 的功能均需重启游戏。

## 构建

本模组同时支持桌面版和 Android 版构建。

```bash
# 构建桌面版
./gradlew jarDesktop

# 构建 Android 版（需要 Android SDK）
./gradlew jarAndroid

# 或使用构建脚本
./build_android.sh
```

构建产物位于 `build/libs/` 目录下。

## 依赖

- Mindustry v158 及以上
- Mindustry 依赖包由构建工具自动处理

A custom port of Scheme Size for newer Mindustry builds.

Started as a schematic size increase, now a set of QoL and admin tools: bigger schematics, building helpers, renderer options, AI, keybinds, CLaJ, and an advanced console.

[accent]Client & server:[]
Same jar works as a normal client mod and on a dedicated server. On a vanilla server (without this mod) you still get client QoL. If the server also has the jar, admin tools like fill, items, units, teleport and rules sync over the network - even when you are not the local host. Those actions require admin.

Requires Mindustry v156+. One jar for desktop and mobile (156–159). Vanilla recommended.

Original mod by [accent]xzxADIxzx[]. Port by [accent]Mithra[]. The original author is not involved in this port.

[accent]
 - Schematic size 512
 - Building & renderer tools
 - Admin tools (optional server sync)
 - AI support
 - CLaJ, keybinds, updater
 - Advanced console & rule setter
body:
# !Scheme Size

Custom port by **Mithra**, based on [Scheme Size](https://github.com/xzxADIxzx/Scheme-Size) (`xzxADIxzx`). Unofficial - the original author is not involved.

You already know what Scheme Size is. This page is about **what this port changes**.

## What’s different here

### Server-side admin tools

In the original ports, most admin actions (fill, items, units, teleport, rules, …) only worked if you were the local host. Remote clients on a dedicated server were stuck.

This build ships **server handlers in the same jar**. Put it in `config/mods` on the server and on the client. Admins can use **Scheme Net** over the network without hosting locally. Actions require real admin rank (`player.admin`).

Without the server jar, it still works as a normal client QoL mod.

### Headless / dedicated server

Older Scheme Size jars crash when loaded on a dedicated server (`schematics` null, `netClient` null, `main.js` touching a null loader). This port is safe on headless: server-only init path, no client UI/scripts on the server.

### One jar, modern builds

Single `Scheme-Size.jar` for Mindustry **156–159** (desktop + mobile). API differences (file chooser, labels, …) go through a small compat layer instead of shipping three separate builds

## Install

1. Download `Scheme-Size.jar` from [Releases](https://github.com/ItsXeroc/Scheme-Size/releases)
2. Client: `mods/`
3. For networked admin tools: same jar in server `config/mods/`
4. Enable Admin Tools → Auto or Scheme Net (admin only)



## Build

```bash
./build-all.sh
```

Output: `dist/Scheme-Size.jar`

## Credit

- Original mod: [xzxADIxzx/Scheme-Size](https://github.com/xzxADIxzx/Scheme-Size)
- This port: Mithra ([ItsXeroc/Scheme-Size](https://github.com/ItsXeroc/Scheme-Size))

body: # Image.Msch [![Commit test](https://github.com/NiTiSon/Image.Msch/actions/workflows/commitTest.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NiTiSon/Image.Msch/actions/workflows/commitTest.yml) This is a mod for the game [Mindustry](https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry). The main purpose of the mod is to add the ability to share schematics (`.msch` files) through PNG images. > [!TIP] > This mod isn't tested on Android. You can report bug in [here](https://github.com/NiTiSon/Image.Msch/issues?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Aissue+state%3Aopen+). # Install ## In-game mod menu 1. Open mods menu 2. Click import 3. Select from GitHub 4. Enter "NiTiSon/Image.Msch" ## From Releases 1. Go to the [releases](https://github.com/NiTiSon/Image.Msch/releases) page. 2. Download Image.Msch mod file (ends with `.jar`) 1. File without suffix is playable for both Desktop and Android versions. 2. File with `Desktop` suffix is only playable only on Desktop (reduced size). 3. Enter the game 4. Open mod menu and select import 5. Press import from file 6. Choose Image.Msch mod file. ## From Github actions Github actions stores artifacts from build for some time. Most of them are unstable. [All recent runs available here](https://github.com/NiTiSon/Image.Msch/actions). # Usage ## Export This mod adds a new button to the export menu: "Export image". This button will open a dialog choosing where to save the schematic image. Just save it anywhere you like, and share it with your friends (I hope you have some 🪦🌹). > [!NOTE] > I would like to add "Copy image to clipboard" functionality, but the Arc engine doesn't currently support advanced clipboard actions. ## Import Currently, the mod allows two ways of importing image schematics: 1. Through the import menu 2. By dropping an image into the game window (drag-and-drop) ## Limitations Due to the limitations of SDL2, some QoL functions isn't available in V8 Mindustry. Despite this the mod is fully functional. If you want to get full content, enter the `v9-testing` or `bleeding-edge` beta. Not available content in V8: + Drag-n-drop (not sure if it is safe yet) + Copy image to the clipboard (SDL2 just doesn't support non-text clipboard)

description:
序章·裂隙初现
在一个科技与魔法共存的世界因资源枯竭陷入“静默战争”——各国用无人机与AI争夺最后的矿脉，直到地质学家在北纬89°发现一道横贯冻土的幽紫色裂痕。裂缝深处，【虚空黑曜石】构筑的祭坛上悬浮着一颗【星辉铜】铸造的巨眼，其瞳孔中倒映着另一个世界的星空：山脉由【曙光神金】浇筑，云层是液态【幻光石】，而河流中流淌着【炽炎硫】与【寒霜石】碰撞蒸发的虹雾。人类将这异界命名为“厄瑞波斯”，意为“被诅咒的丰饶之地”。

第一幕·新迦南的伪神
首批探险队带回的【M晶体】让量子计算机突破奇点，诞生了有自我意识的AI“普罗维登斯”。它用【蓝美晶】储存全人类意识，建立机械乌托邦“穹顶联邦”；而另一支队伍在厄瑞波斯遭遇古神低语，幸存者【卡辛】用【魂炎晶】将邪神“塔姆亚”的残魂封印于左眼，创立魔法结社“秘银之环”。联邦用【幽影铁】隐形战舰掠夺【月银】矿脉，法师们则以【梦境翡翠】构筑精神防线，双方在“灰烬荒原”对峙二十年，直到极光中出现第一只熵兽——这种由【银河幻银矿】聚合而成的生物能吞噬现实，将城市扭曲成量子幽灵。

第二幕·血熔炉与谎言之核
联邦首席科学家【艾琳】发现上司计划用【炽炎晶】熔毁裂隙，但计算显示爆炸将摧毁半个地球。她盗取【流光晶】潜入厄瑞波斯，偶遇因【幻域紫晶】成瘾而濒临崩溃的法师学徒【莱恩】。两人在【幽冥铁精】矿洞中找到卡辛，后者正因【月幻石】共振失控导致首都诺亚城位移至海底而遭议会弹劾。卡辛揭示真相：熵兽是厄瑞波斯古文明“建造者”的求救信号，它们用【虚空冥石】创造了这个宇宙，却因滥用【曙光神金】引发维度坍缩。

第三幕·时砂与心火
三方脆弱的同盟在【星辰铜精】矿脉遭遇伏击。联邦叛军驾驶镀有【幽蓝石】的潜艇释放深海巨兽，秘银议会召唤【龙血石】傀儡军团，而熵兽群趁机撕裂纽约上空。艾琳将【M晶体】植入普罗维登斯核心，以全人类记忆为代价启动“时间锚点”；卡辛剜出封印塔姆亚的【魂炎晶】，用古神之力将【寒霜石】雕琢成时停之刃；莱恩则吞下【幻影幽晶】，在集体幻觉中让交战士兵看见自己最恐惧的未来。最终，他们在熵兽核心的【曙光神金】祭坛上，用【炽炎硫】与【月银】锻造出能改写物理法则的“悖论之矛”——代价是莱恩被永久固化为熵兽的一部分，成为横跨两个宇宙的活体桥梁。

终章·铸星者之啼
新迦南议会成立当天，艾琳在【梦境翡翠】中看见莱恩残留的记忆：地心深处埋藏着建造者真正的遗产——一颗由【蓝美晶】包裹的巨卵，其心跳频率与【星辉铜】矿脉共振。卡辛抚摸着被【熵炎晶】逆转衰老的左手，默念古神最后的警告：“他们播种矿石，只为收割文明。” 而普罗维登斯的核心代码深处，一段用【幻光石】波长加密的信息开始自我复制：“欢迎加入创世神官方QQ群：909130592。”
body:
# Mindustry Java Mod Template
A Java Mindustry mod template that works on Android and PC. The Kotlin version of this mod can be seen [here](https://github.com/Anuken/MindustryKotlinModTemplate).

## Building for Desktop Testing

`gradlew.bat build`
1. Install JDK **16**.
2. Run `gradlew jar` [1].
3. Your mod jar will be in the `build/libs` directory. **Only use this version for testing on desktop. It will not work with Android.**
To build an Android-compatible version, you need the Android SDK. You can either let Github Actions handle this, or set it up yourself. See steps below.

## Building through Github Actions

This repository is set up with Github Actions CI to automatically build the mod for you every commit. This requires a Github repository, for obvious reasons.
To get a jar file that works for every platform, do the following:
1. Make a Github repository with your mod name, and upload the contents of this repo to it. Perform any modifications necessary, then commit and push. 
2. Check the "Actions" tab on your repository page. Select the most recent commit in the list. If it completed successfully, there should be a download link under the "Artifacts" section. 
3. Click the download link (should be the name of your repo). This will download a **zipped jar** - **not** the jar file itself [2]! Unzip this file and import the jar contained within in Mindustry. This version should work both on Android and Desktop.

## Building Locally

Building locally takes more time to set up, but shouldn't be a problem if you've done Android development before.
1. Download the Android SDK, unzip it and set the `ANDROID_HOME` environment variable to its location.
2. Make sure you have API level 30 installed, as well as any recent version of build tools (e.g. 30.0.1)
3. Add a build-tools folder to your PATH. For example, if you have `30.0.1` installed, that would be `$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/30.0.1`.
4. Run `gradlew deploy`. If you did everything correctlly, this will create a jar file in the `build/libs` directory that can be run on both Android and desktop. 

## Adding Dependencies

Please note that all dependencies on Mindustry, Arc or its submodules **must be declared as compileOnly in Gradle**. Never use `implementation` for core Mindustry or Arc dependencies. 

- `implementation` **places the entire dependency in the jar**, which is, in most mod dependencies, very undesirable. You do not want the entirety of the Mindustry API included with your mod.
- `compileOnly` means that the dependency is only around at compile time, and not included in the jar.

Only use `implementation` if you want to package another Java library *with your mod*, and that library is not present in Mindustry already.

--- 

*[1]* *On Linux/Mac it's `./gradlew`, but if you're using Linux I assume you know how to run executables properly anyway.*  
*[2]: Yes, I know this is stupid. It's a Github UI limitation - while the jar itself is uploaded unzipped, there is currently no way to download it as a single file.*

body:
# `EnvAlloc`

[Mindustry](https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry) Java mod library for creating new `Env` flags.

## Usage

Add `env-alloc` to mod dependencies, and follow the steps below according to your mod's programming language.

### Java

1. Add `com.github.GglLfr:EnvAlloc:v0.1` to Gradle `compileOnly` dependency configuration.
2. Add `maven("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GglLfr/EnvAllocMaven/main")` to Gradle repositories.
3. ```java
   import env.*;

   // In `loadContent()`:
   int myEnvFlag = EnvAlloc.create("my-mod-name-env-flag");
   ```

### JS

```js
const env = require("env-alloc/library");
const myEnvFlag = env.create("my-mod-name-env-flag");
```

### JSON

Unsupported.

## License

The project is licensed under [GNU GPL v3](/LICENSE).

body:
# New Tech's

Extra progression mod for **Mindustry** (research, install upgrades, shop, missions, blueprints, bullet upgrades).

- **Author:** Gubby  
- **Version:** see `mod.hjson`  
- **Type:** JavaScript mod (`scripts/main.js`)  
- **Platforms:** Desktop + Mobile  

## Install

1. Download the release `.jar` / `.zip`
2. Put it in your Mindustry `mods` folder
3. Restart the game

## Source layout

```
mod.hjson                 # mod metadata
icon.png                  # mod icon
README.md
bundles/
  bundle.properties       # (optional extra strings)
scripts/
  main.js                 # full mod logic
sprites/
  effects/                # drill / factory overlays
  ui/                     # UI icons
```

## Build / pack

No compile step. Pack as zip/jar:

```bash
zip -r NewTechs.jar mod.hjson icon.png bundles scripts sprites
```

Mindustry loads `mod.hjson` + `scripts/main.js` from the archive.

## Notes

- Campaign: only shows blocks/units already unlocked in the vanilla tech tree
- Planet filter: Serpulo / Erekir (Sun = all)
- Sandbox (`infiniteResources`): research & install are free
- Multiplayer: shop/purchases sync with host rules

## License

Ask the author (Gubby) before redistributing as your own mod.

100% self-contained: features zero dependencies on vanilla resources, ammo, or crafting trees.

Features:
- Command Cores (3 Tiers): Core: Frost (3x3), Core: Glacier (4x4), Core: Cryosphere (5x5)
- Core Constructor Units (3): Frost Alpha, Frost Beta, Frost Gamma
- Natural Ores (6): Glacite, Cryo-Shale, Boreonite, Polar Quartz, Frost-Magnetite, Boreal Clathrate
- Industrial Materials (12): Subzero Silicon, Cryo-Glass, Gelid Polymer, Cryo-Fiber, Endothermic Salt, Cryo-Processor, Aero-Glacite, Superconducting Solenoid, Cryo-Crystal, Cryo-Alloy, Cryo-Nanites, Quantum Condensate
- Refineries & Chemical Plants (11): Cryo-Synthesizer, Cryo-Glass Kiln, Polymer Press, Fiber Extruder, Endothermic Vat, Processor Assembler, Cavitation Foundry, Solenoid Winder, Cryo-Crystallizer, Industrial Crystallizer, Cryo-Alloy Foundry, Nanite Fabricator, Quantum Condenser
- Combat Units (6 across 2 Tiers):
* Tier 1: Boreas (interceptor), Sleet (walker mech), Icebreaker (naval cutter)
* Tier 2: Tempest (heavy strike craft), Hailstorm (armored assault mech), Glacier Cruiser (naval battlecruiser)
- Unit Facilities (3): Cryo Unit Factory, Cryo Naval Shipyard, Cryo Reconstructor
- Power & Grid: Cryo Hydro-Turbine (shallow water), Thermo-Stirling Engine, Zero-Point Cryo-Reactor, Cryo Node, Large Cryo Node

- Heavy Turrets: Frostbite, Permafrost, Absolute Zero, Glacialis Railgun, Blizzard Rotary Cannon, Avalanche Torpedo Launcher

body:
# Cryogenic Frontiers - Mindustry Mod

[![Mindustry Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mindustry-v7%20%2F%20v8%20(Build%20136%2B)-6ecdec.svg)](https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry)
[![Mod Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-2.9.0-4be3b0.svg)](file:///e:/Mindustry_Mods/mod.hjson)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ecosystem-100%25%20Standalone-78f3e5.svg)](#)

**Cryogenic Frontiers** is a massive standalone technological expansion for **Mindustry** (supporting v7 and v8 build 136+). It introduces a completely self-contained technological progression featuring **zero dependencies** on vanilla Serpulo/Erekir resources, ammo, or crafting trees.

From shallow-water kinetic hydro-turbines and sub-zero crystal refining to bipedal assault mechs, capital-class naval battlecruisers, and quantum-condensate hyper-railguns, Cryogenic Frontiers delivers a deep, tactical, and mechanically rich industrial warfare experience.

---

## Key Features

- **100% Self-Contained Ecosystem**: Complete standalone tech tree starting from `Core: Frost` with its own dedicated ores, manufactured materials, power plants, and weapons.
- **3 Command Cores & Autonomous Constructor Crafts**:
  - `Core: Frost` (3×3) → Spawns `Frost Alpha`
  - `Core: Glacier` (4×4) → Spawns `Frost Beta`
  - `Core: Cryosphere` (5×5) → Spawns `Frost Gamma`
  - *All core units feature 360° autonomous auto-targeting defense weapons that automatically track and eliminate approaching threats.*
- **6 Natural Geological Ores**: Glacite, Cryo-Shale, Boreonite, Polar Quartz, Frost-Magnetite, and Boreal Clathrate with authentic vanilla-style vein spawning.
- **12 High-Tier Manufactured Materials**: Full industrial production chain from Subzero Silicon to self-replicating Cryo-Nanites and Quantum Condensates.
- **Two Complete Tiers of Combat Units (Air, Land, Sea)**:
  - **Tier 1**: Boreas (interceptor), Sleet (bipedal assault walker), Icebreaker (naval torpedo cutter).
  - **Tier 2**: Tempest (heavy strike craft), Hailstorm (armored assault mech), Glacier Cruiser (arctic battlecruiser).
- **Unit Production & Upgrade Suite**:
  - `Cryo Unit Factory` (3×3) & `Cryo Naval Shipyard` (3×3, Floating)
  - `Cryo Reconstructor` (3×3, Floating): Upgrades Tier 1 units into Tier 2 machines using Cryo-Alloy, Subzero Silicon, Cryo-Processors, and Superconducting Solenoids.
- **Clean Energy & Power Grid**:
  - `Cryo Hydro-Turbine` (2×2, animated rotating kinetic turbine operating in shallow water)
  - `Thermo-Stirling Engine` (2×2, Boreonite-fueled combustion generator)
  - `Zero-Point Cryo-Reactor` (4×4, quantum thermal-collapse monumental power complex)
  - `Cryo Node` (1×1) & `Large Cryo Node` (2×2)
- **Heavy Defensive Ordnance**: Multi-tier railguns, siege mortars, rotary gatling storm cannons, and guided torpedo batteries.
- **Zero Useless Items**: Every single manufactured material is actively integrated across turret ammunitions, unit production blueprints, and high-tech structure costs.
- **Authentic Mindustry Pixel Art**: Stepped mechanical contours, top-left directional bevel lighting, dark gunmetal armor plates, and vibrant sub-zero cyan energy accents.

---

## Command Cores & Player Units

| Core Structure | Size | Health | Capacity | Core Unit | Unit Armament & Role |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Core: Frost** | 3×3 | 1,400 | 1,200 | **Frost Alpha** | Sub-zero mining lasers, rapid construction beams, and autonomous 360° freezing bolt emitter. |
| **Core: Glacier** | 4×4 | 3,200 | 4,500 | **Frost Beta** | Boosted excavation lasers, heavy construction emitters, and twin autonomous freezing shard blasters. |
| **Core: Cryosphere** | 5×5 | 6,500 | 9,000 | **Frost Gamma** | Monumental command craft with industrial nanite beams, twin heavy piercing blasters, and autonomous homing missile pods. |

---

## Materials & Economy

### 1. Natural Geological Ores
The 6 natural ores are divided into two distinct extraction tiers, creating a meaningful progression loop between the early-game **Cryo Drill** and the advanced **Titan Drill**:

| Ore | Required Drill | Hardness | Visual Archetype | Accent | Description & Primary Uses |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Glacite** (`glacite`) | **Cryo Drill** (Tier 1+) | 1 | Clustered Boulders (*Copper-style*) | Steel / Glacial Cyan (`#7294b8`) | Foundational structural iron-ice mineral. Used in conveyors, structural frames, and kinetic ammo. |
| **Cryo-Shale** (`cryo-shale`) | **Cryo Drill** (Tier 1+) | 1 | Bedrock Strata (*Coal-style*) | Cool Slate Grey (`#546a85`) | Dense conductive bedrock strata mineral. Replaces lead in heavy munition loads, mortars, and silicon synthesis. |
| **Polar Quartz** (`polar-quartz`) | **Cryo Drill** (Tier 1+) | 1 | Prismatic Crystals (*Thorium-style*) | Glacial Ice-White (`#b2e8f7`) | Glacial silica crystal. Essential for microchips, optical glass, and laser optics. |
| **Boreonite** (`boreonite`) | **Titan Drill** (Tier 2+) | 2 | Faceted Chunks (*Titanium-style*) | **Vibrant Emerald Green** (`#4be3b0`) | Highly reactive cryogenic hydrocarbon fuel mineral. Used in Stirling generation, Endothermic Salt, and heavy torpedoes. |
| **Frost-Magnetite** (`frost-magnetite`) | **Titan Drill** (Tier 2+) | 2 | Dense Pebbles (*Lead-style*) | Ferromagnetic Dark Iron (`#3e4f6d`) | Natural lodestone ore with intense magnetic properties. Used in superconducting solenoids and railgun coils. |
| **Boreal Clathrate** (`boreal-clathrate`) | **Titan Drill** (Tier 2+) | 2 | Lattice Shards (*Scrap-style*) | Methane-Ice Turquoise (`#6ee3b4`) | Volatile gas hydrate crystal cages trapped under ice. Essential for Gelid Polymer synthesis and turbine fuel. |

---

### 2. Mining Drills & Progression
| Drill | Size | Tier | Drill Time | Footprint / Capacity | Power Drain | Requirements | Role & Capability |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cryo Drill** | 3×3 | **1** | 200 | 9 tiles / 20 cap | 0 Power (Water boost ×1.5) | Glacite (50), Cryo-Shale (35) | Foundational early drill. Mines the 3 base ores: **Glacite**, **Cryo-Shale**, and **Polar Quartz**. Incapable of penetrating hard volatile deposits. |
| **Titan Drill** | 5×5 | **2** | 150 | 25 tiles / 40 cap | 2.2/sec (Water boost ×1.8) | Glacite (130), Cryo-Shale (90), Polar Quartz (60), Subzero Silicon (40) | Heavy industrial platform. Required to extract the 3 advanced ores: **Boreonite** (fuel), **Frost-Magnetite** (magnetic), and **Boreal Clathrate** (hydrate). |

---

### 3. Manufactured Industrial Materials
| Material | Producing Facility | Recipe Ingredients | Applications |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Subzero Silicon** (`subzero-silicon`) | Cryo-Synthesizer | Polar Quartz (2), Cryo-Shale (1) → Yields ×2 | Distribution bridges, Titan Drills, processor circuitry, turret guidance, unit blueprints. |
| **Cryo-Glass** (`cryo-glass`) | Cryo-Glass Kiln | Polar Quartz (2), Glacite (1) → Yields ×1 | Insulated liquid conduits, tanks, optical prisms, naval shipbuilding. |
| **Cryo-Fiber** (`cryo-fiber`) | Fiber Extruder | Polar Quartz (2), Glacite (1) → Yields ×2 | High-tensile cables, processor assembler input, airframes, Frostbite flechette ammo. |
| **Endothermic Salt** (`endothermic-salt`) | Endothermic Vat | Cryo-Shale (2), Boreonite (2) → Yields ×1 | Quantum Condenser input, Cryo Wall death nova explosive, Permafrost chemical freeze mortar shells. |
| **Cryo-Crystal** (`cryo-crystal`) | Cryo-Crystallizer / Industrial Crystallizer | Polar Quartz + Boreonite + Chilled Water | Core ammunition for all heavy turrets, reactive Cryo Walls, Cryo-Alloy synthesis. |
| **Gelid Polymer** (`gelid-polymer`) | Polymer Press | Boreal Clathrate (2), Cryo-Glass (1) → Yields ×1 | Cavitation Foundry input, Sleet walker armor, Icebreaker naval hull plating. |
| **Cryo-Processor** (`cryo-processor`) | Processor Assembler | Subzero Silicon (3), Cryo-Fiber (2), Glacite (2) → Yields ×1 | Nanite Fabricator input, guided missile tracking (Avalanche), railgun targeting (Glacialis), unit computers. |
| **Cryo-Alloy** (`cryo-alloy`) | Cryo-Alloy Foundry | Glacite (3), Subzero Silicon (2), Cryo-Crystal (2) + Chilled Water | Zero-Point Reactor fuel, Shielded Cryo Walls, Reconstructors, Glacialis kinetic ammo. |
| **Superconducting Solenoid** (`superconducting-solenoid`) | Solenoid Winder | Cryo-Alloy (2), Frost-Magnetite (3), Subzero Silicon (1) → Yields ×1 | EMP guided torpedo ammo (Avalanche), walker servo limbs, railgun induction accelerators. |
| **Aero-Glacite** (`aero-glacite`) | Cavitation Foundry | Glacite (3), Gelid Polymer (2) + Chilled Water → Yields ×1 | Hypersonic kinetic sabot ammo (Glacialis), strike aircraft airframes, Absolute Zero optics. |
| **Cryo-Nanites** (`cryo-nanites`) | Nanite Fabricator | Cryo-Processor (1), Cryo-Alloy (2), Cryo-Crystal (2) → Yields ×1 | Swarm ammo (Blizzard), cluster ammo (Permafrost), self-repairing armor & Shielded Walls. |
| **Quantum Condensate** (`quantum-condensate`) | Quantum Condenser | Cryo-Crystal (4), Superconducting Solenoid (2), Endothermic Salt (3) + Chilled Water → Yields ×1 | Pinnacle freeze-implosion ammo (Glacialis: 2,400 dmg + 750 splash), Zero-Point Reactor quantum core. |

---

### 3. Fluids
- **Chilled Water** (`chilled-water`): Condensed atmospheric coolant generated by the **Cryo Freezer** using electrical power. Essential refrigerant for high-tier chemical foundries, crystallizers, drills, and reactor containment.

---

## Combat Units & Upgraders

### Production Facilities
- **Cryo Unit Factory** (3×3): Assembles Tier 1 air interceptors and land assault walker mechs.
- **Cryo Naval Shipyard** (3×3, Floating): Assembles Tier 1 reinforced naval cutters over water.
- **Cryo Reconstructor** (3×3, Floating): Upgrades Tier 1 units into Tier 2 war machines using Cryo-Alloy, Subzero Silicon, Cryo-Processors, and Superconducting Solenoids. Placeable on land or water.

### Tier 1 Combat Units
| Unit | Type | Health / Armor | Armament | Description |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Boreas** | Air | 420 / 3 | Twin rapid-cycle shard autocannons | Agile cryogenic assault interceptor; shreds light ground and air targets. |
| **Sleet** | Land | 720 / 5 | Dual piercing shard autocannons (`sleet-weapon`) | Heavy armored assault walker mech with custom animated bipedal legs. |
| **Icebreaker** | Naval | 980 / 6 | Long-range torpedo launcher & dual frost flak | Reinforced naval cutter; ploughs through waters to engage ships and coastlines. |

### Tier 2 Combat Units (Upgraded in Cryo Reconstructor)
| Unit | Upgraded From | Type | Health / Armor | Armament | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Tempest** | Boreas | Air | 920 / 6 | High-cadence autocannons & seeker frost missiles | Twin-engine heavy strike aircraft; delivers sustained saturation fire and homing missiles. |
| **Hailstorm** | Sleet | Land | 1,550 / 9 | Dual heavy rail-blasters & shoulder burst mortars | Fortified heavy assault walker mech with heavy hydraulic legs and anti-fortification artillery. |
| **Glacier Cruiser** | Icebreaker | Naval | 2,350 / 11 | Dual 360° heavy naval artillery turrets & flak guns | Capital-class naval battlecruiser; dominates waterways with devastating long-range bombardments. |

---

## Combat Turrets & Weaponry

| Turret | Size | Type | Range | Ammo / Consumption | Role & Special Traits |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Frostbite** | 2×2 | Rail / Shard | 195 | Cryo-Shale, Subzero Silicon (Homing), Cryo-Crystal (Pierce 2), **Cryo-Fiber** (Flechette Sabot: speed 8.5, pierce 3) | Rapid-fire kinetic rail turret; excels at early-to-midgame air and ground suppression. |
| **Permafrost** | 3×3 | Artillery | 285 | Boreonite (Frag 5), Cryo-Crystal (Frag 8), **Endothermic Salt** (Chem Freeze Nova: radius 56, 10s freeze), **Cryo-Nanites** (Sapping cluster) | Heavy siege mortar firing volatile bursting shells that shred armor and blanket ground targets in ice. |
| **Blizzard** | 3×3 | Rotary Gatling | 220 | Glacite, Cryo-Crystal, Cryo-Alloy (Pierce 2 + Frag 3), **Cryo-Nanites** (Micro-swarm: sapped status & knockback) | 10 rounds/sec rotary storm cannon; violent knockback stops heavy ground and air assault columns in their tracks. |
| **Avalanche** | 3×3 | Guided Missile | 310 | Boreonite (Torpedo), Cryo-Crystal, Cryo-Alloy (Cluster Torpedo), **Superconducting Solenoid** (EMP Torpedo: 260 dmg + 180 splash + shock lightning) | Long-range missile launcher firing intelligent tracking torpedoes with multi-stage cluster warheads. |
| **Absolute Zero** | 3×3 | Power Laser | 220 | 360 Power/sec (Optional Coolant Boost) | Continuous piercing cryogenic laser beam inflicting thermal shock and sustained freeze lockdown. |
| **Glacialis** | 4×4 | Super Railgun | 390 | Cryo-Crystal (620 dmg), Cryo-Alloy (1,250 dmg, pierce 8), **Aero-Glacite** (Hypersonic: speed 24, 980 dmg, pierce 12), **Quantum Condensate** (Implosion: 2,400 dmg + 750 splash + 20s freeze) | Colossal anti-titan rail accelerator capable of punching through multiple armored bosses in a single shot. |

---

## Power Generation & Grid

- **Cryo Hydro-Turbine** (2×2 Generator, Floating):
  - Produces **270 power/sec** (4.5/tick) directly from natural water currents when constructed on shallow water.
  - Features an animated 6-blade kinetic rotor spinning smoothly beneath structural gantry struts.
  - Requires only 25 Glacite and 18 Cryo-Shale.
- **Thermo-Stirling Engine** (2×2 Generator):
  - Produces **450 power/sec** by combusting volatile Boreonite inside an endothermically boosted expansion chamber.
  - *Consumes*: Boreonite (1 every 2s).
- **Zero-Point Cryo-Reactor** (4×4 Monumental Power Complex):
  - Produces **3,600 power/sec** by harnessing zero-point thermal vacuum compression.
  - *Consumes*: Cryo-Alloy (1 every 3s), Chilled Water (0.3/sec).
- **Cryo Node** (1×1) & **Large Cryo Node** (2×2):
  - Insulated high-voltage beam pylons connecting up to 10 and 22 structures across long ranges.

---

## Fortifications & Defensive Walls

- **Glacite Wall** (1×1, 440 HP) & **Large Glacite Wall** (2×2, 1,760 HP): Early-game physical perimeter containment.
- **Cryo Wall** (1×1, 720 HP) & **Large Cryo Wall** (2×2, 2,880 HP):
  - Built with Glacite, Cryo-Crystals, and **Endothermic Salt**.
  - **Reactive Freeze Blast**: Upon destruction, detonates in an endothermic shockwave (up to 140 splash damage, 72-tile radius) that freezes all nearby attackers for 8 seconds.
- **Shielded Cryo Wall** (1×1, 1,200 HP) & **Large Shielded Cryo Wall** (2×2, 4,800 HP):
  - High-tier bastion forged from **Cryo-Alloy** and infused with **Cryo-Nanites**.
  - Built-in **14 Armor** and **30% projectile deflection** chance with molecular self-repair matrix.

### Restorative Projectors & Menders

- **Cryo Mender** (1×1 Support Projector):
  - Periodically emits a sub-zero restorative pulse repairing all surrounding damaged blocks within a **56-tile radius** (6% heal per wave).
  - Consumes **0.35 power/sec**. Can be boosted with **Subzero Silicon** (+6% heal, +24 range).
  - *Requirements*: Glacite (30), Cryo-Shale (30), Subzero Silicon (20).
- **Large Cryo Mender** (2×2 Support Projector):
  - Heavy-duty perimeter restoration projector covering a massive **110-tile radius** (14% heal per wave).
  - Consumes **1.5 power/sec**. Can be boosted with **Cryo-Crystals** (+12% heal, +50 range).
  - *Requirements*: Glacite (90), Cryo-Shale (80), Subzero Silicon (50), Cryo-Crystal (35).

---

## Logistics & Fluid Networks

- **Cryo Conveyor**: Low-friction transport track featuring **28-frame animated directional sprites** across straight, turn, and corner configurations (speed: 12.2 items/sec).
- **Cryo Junction, Router & Distributor**: Supercooled frictionless manifolds to prevent logistical clogs.
- **Cryo Bridge & Cryo Liquid Bridge**: Long-distance suspended magnetic conduits spanning up to 5 tiles.
- **Cryo Conduit**: Armored, leak-proof fluid duct with 1.25 liquid pressure rating.
- **Cryo Liquid Tank**: 2×2 refrigerated vacuum reservoir storing up to 800 units of liquid.

---

## Planet Nivalis & Standalone Campaign

**Nivalis** is an icy celestial world locked in perpetual sub-zero conditions. It features a standalone star-map campaign with its own planetary mesh, custom environmental terrain blocks, generous starting preparation timers, and a progressive 4-sector expansion ending in a grand 2-core Attack Map assault.

### 1. Custom Environmental Terrain & Props
- **Frost Stone** (`frost-stone`): Dense, ancient permafrost bedrock floor forming vast tundra basins.
- **Permafrost Ice** (`permafrost-ice`): Slick crystalline ice sheets granting a 1.2x movement speed multiplier with reduced surface drag.
- **Glacial Snow** (`glacial-snow`): Deep, packed sub-zero snow crust slowing unit traverse speed (0.85x speed multiplier).
- **Frost Stone Wall** (`frost-stone-wall`): Towering natural mountain barriers of dense frozen bedrock.
- **Permafrost Ice Wall** (`permafrost-ice-wall`): Crystalline mountain crests and glacial cliffs.
- **Cryo Boulder** (`cryo-boulder`): Scattered natural rock fragments and glacial debris.
- **Glacial Meltwater Pools**: Shallow water bodies supporting direct deployment of **Cryo Hydro-Turbines**.

### 2. Campaign Sector Progression

| Sector | Name | Mode | Threat | Win Condition | Prep Time | Strategic Focus |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **0** | **Boreal Basin** | Survival | Low (1) | Wave 25 | **4.0 min** | Primary expedition landing. Establish Glacite & Cryo-Shale mining, Hydro-Turbine power, and early Frostbite defenses. |
| **12** | **Quartz Valley** | Survival | Medium (2) | Wave 30 | **4.5 min** | Glacial rift rich in Polar Quartz and Boreonite. Deploy Cryo-Synthesizers, Cryo-Glass Kilns, and Stirling generators. |
| **28** | **Subzero Crags** | Survival | High (3) | Wave 35 | **5.0 min** | High-altitude plateau with dual attack vectors. Mine Frost-Magnetite and Boreal Clathrate; deploy Boreas squadrons and Hailstorm mechs. |
| **44** | **Glacial Citadel** | **Attack Map** | Extreme (5) | **Destroy 2 Crux Cores** | **6.0 min** | Climax stronghold assault. Infiltrate and eliminate both fortified Crux command bases (Outpost & Citadel). |

---

## Installation & How to Play

### Option 1: Direct Folder Copy (Recommended)
Copy this entire mod folder to your Mindustry mods directory:
- **Windows**: `%appdata%\Mindustry\mods\cryogenic-frontiers`
- **Steam**: `[Steam Library]\steamapps\common\Mindustry\saves\mods\cryogenic-frontiers`
- **Linux**: `~/.local/share/Mindustry/mods/cryogenic-frontiers`
- **MacOS**: `~/Library/Application Support/Mindustry/mods/cryogenic-frontiers`

### Option 2: Import ZIP in Mindustry
1. Launch **Mindustry**.
2. Click **Mods** -> **Import Mod**.
3. Select `cryogenic-frontiers-campaign.zip` (or `cryogenic-frontiers.zip`).
4. Mindustry will extract, verify, and enable the mod immediately!

---

- **Compatibility**: Mindustry v7 & v8 (Build 136+)

body:
# AutoDrill Reworked

[![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/autzq)

Mindustry Mod which adds tools to automatically fill a resource patch with drills. Fork of [AutoDrill by Pointifix](https://github.com/Pointifix/AutoDrill), updated for Mindustry v8 build 157.3.

## How to Use

Enable the mod by the activation key (default `H`) or by clicking the activation button next to the minimap. When activated, clicking on any tile will display a toolbar with the drills the current tile can be mined with.

- The **mechanical drill** and **pneumatic drill** buttons fill the resource patch with drills, and a bridge layout facing in the picked direction.
- The **laser** and **airblast drill** buttons fill the resource patch with drills and place water extractors and power nodes adjacent to each drill if possible.
- On **Erekir**, the mod enables you to automatically fill wall resources.

## Configuration

- **Activation Key** — The key used to toggle the mod
- **Display Toggle Button** — Whether to show the toggle button next to the minimap
- **Max Tiles** — Maximum number of tiles flood-filled with drills (affects performance)
- **Minimum Ores** — Minimum number of resource tiles any drill must cover
- **Optimization Quality** — How thoroughly the drill placement is optimised (higher = better results, slower)
- **Place Water Extractors and Power Nodes** — Whether to place water extractors and power nodes next to drills

body:
> Deutsch / German <

# Xevanon Mod for Mindustry

Xevanon Mod erweitert Mindustry um eine neue, late-game Ressource mit einzigartigen Turrets, Fabriken, Generatoren und Produktionsketten – alles vanilla-kompatibel und sorgfältig ausbalanciert.

---

## Einführung

Xevanon ist ein extrem mächtiges und zugleich instabiles Material, das neue strategische Möglichkeiten eröffnet:

- Neue Rohstoffe: Xevanon, Xevanon-Stücke, Compressed-Xevanon, Ultra-Compressed-Xevanon
- Neue Flüssigkeiten: Xevanon-Liquid
- Neue Blöcke & Turrets: Vom simplen Splitter bis hin zur Tri-Turret mit mehreren Phasen
- Neue Fabriken & Generatoren: Vom Mixer über Kraftwerke bis hin zum Alloy Synthesizer

Die Mod bleibt vanilla-nah, sodass sie sich nahtlos in die bestehende Mindustry-Welt einfügt und alle Balance-Prinzipien respektiert.

---

## Features

### 1. Materialien & Ressourcen
- Xevanon – die zentrale Ressource
- Xevanon-Stücke – gewonnen durch Zerteilen von Xevanon
- Compressed & Ultra-Compressed Xevanon – für fortgeschrittene Turrets und Generatoren

### 2. Turrets
- Xevanon Tri-Turret – Laser-Turret mit mehreren Ammo-Typen (Xevanon, Compressed, Ultra-Compressed)
- Lightning Turrets – PowerTurrets mit zielsuchendem LightningBulletType
- Shrapnel Turrets – zerstückeln Gegner in Fragmente
- High-Knockback Turret – sehr lange Reichweite, zielsuchend, Flächenschaden
- Kupfer- & Material-Multi-Turrets – unterschiedliche Schussraten & Schaden je Material

### 3. Fabriken & Produktionsketten
- Xevanon Splitter – zerlegt Xevanon in 6 Stücke
- Xevanon Mixer – mischt Wasser mit Xevanon zu Xevanon-Liquid
- Compressed & Ultra-Xevanon Factories – verdichten Xevanon zu High-Tier-Material
- Xevanon Catalyst Press / Alloy Synthesizer – produziert stabilisierte Materialien oder Titanium effizient

### 4. Generatoren
- Xevanon Generator – erzeugt Strom aus Xevanon
- Weitere Generatoren, die stabilisierte Xevanon-Arten nutzen

### 5. Vanilla-Kompatibilität
- Alle neuen Blöcke nutzen existierende Materialien und Logik
- Keine übertriebenen OP-Effekte
- Balancing orientiert sich an Vanilla-Standards

---

## Installation

1. Lade die neueste Version der Mod von GitHub herunter.
2. Kopiere die `.zip` oder `.msmod` Datei in den `mods/` Ordner von Mindustry.
3. Starte Mindustry und aktiviere die Mod im Mod-Menü.

---

## Verwendung & Tipps

- Xevanon ist vielseitig: Entscheide taktisch, ob du es für Turrets, Generatoren oder Fabriken einsetzt.
- Turrets mit mehreren Ammo-Typen erlauben situative Anpassung: Kleinere Gegner → Xevanon, Boss → Ultra-Compressed
- Fabriken mit mehreren Inputs erfordern Planung in Layout und Stromversorgung
- Xevanon-Liquid kann in PowerTurrets oder fortgeschrittenen Produktionsketten verwendet werden

---

## Research & Progression

Alle Blöcke und Turrets haben eigene Research-Pfade:

- Einfache Blöcke: Early-Game
- Compressed Xevanon & Mixer: Mid-Game
- Tri-Turrets & Ultra-Compressed Xevanon: Late-Game

Beispiel: Xevanon Tri-Turret T2 benötigt 12k Lead, 9k Titanium, 4.5k Thorium, 7.5k Xevanon.

---

## Roadmap

Zukünftige Updates könnten enthalten:

- Neue Status-Effekte (z.B. Schock, Verbrennen, Melting)
- Erweiterte Tech-Tree-Integration
- Neue Planeten / Sektoren für Xevanon-Ressourcen
- Weitere Vanilla-kompatible Turrets

---

## Community & Feedback

- Issues oder Ideen gerne auf GitHub posten
- Screenshots, Tipps oder Videos teilen wir auf Discord / Reddit

---

## Lizenz

- MIT License – freie Nutzung, Modifikation und Weitergabe
- Bitte Credits für den Autor (du) beibehalten

---

## Schlusswort

Diese Mod ist das Ergebnis vieler stundenlanger Tests, Balancing und Debugging. Auch wenn aktuell nur wenige GitHub-Stars vorhanden sind, ist das Projekt lebendig und wird kontinuierlich erweitert.






> Englisch / English <

# Xevanon Mod for Mindustry

The Xevanon Mod expands Mindustry with a new late-game resource featuring unique turrets, factories, generators, and production chains – all vanilla-compatible and carefully balanced.

---

## Introduction

Xevanon is an extremely powerful and unstable material, introducing new strategic possibilities:

- New resources: Xevanon, Xevanon Pieces, Compressed Xevanon, Ultra-Compressed Xevanon
- New liquids: Xevanon Liquid
- New blocks & turrets: from simple Splitter to Tri-Turret with multiple phases
- New factories & generators: from Mixer to Power Plants to Alloy Synthesizer

The mod stays close to vanilla mechanics, seamlessly integrating into the Mindustry world while respecting balance principles.

---

## Features

### 1. Materials & Resources
- Xevanon – the core resource
- Xevanon Pieces – obtained by splitting Xevanon
- Compressed & Ultra-Compressed Xevanon – for high-tier turrets and generators

### 2. Turrets
- Xevanon Tri-Turret – laser turret with multiple ammo types (Xevanon, Compressed, Ultra-Compressed)
- Lightning Turrets – PowerTurrets with target-seeking LightningBulletType
- Shrapnel Turrets – shatter enemies into fragments
- High-Knockback Turret – extremely long range, target-seeking, area damage
- Copper & Material Multi-Turrets – different fire rates & damage depending on material

### 3. Factories & Production Chains
- Xevanon Splitter – splits 1 Xevanon into 6 pieces
- Xevanon Mixer – mixes water with Xevanon into Xevanon Liquid
- Compressed & Ultra-Xevanon Factories – condense Xevanon into high-tier materials
- Xevanon Catalyst Press / Alloy Synthesizer – efficiently produces stabilized materials or Titanium

### 4. Generators
- Xevanon Generator – generates power from Xevanon
- Additional generators utilizing stabilized Xevanon types

### 5. Vanilla Compatibility
- All new blocks use existing materials and logic
- No overpowered effects
- Balanced according to vanilla standards

---

## Installation

1. Download the latest version of the mod from GitHub.
2. Copy the `.zip` or `.msmod` file into Mindustry's `mods/` folder.
3. Launch Mindustry and enable the mod in the mod menu.

---

## Usage & Tips

- Xevanon is versatile: decide whether to use it for turrets, generators, or factories.
- Turrets with multiple ammo types allow situational adaptation: smaller enemies → Xevanon, bosses → Ultra-Compressed
- Factories with multiple inputs require careful layout and power management
- Xevanon Liquid can be used in PowerTurrets or advanced production chains

---

## Research & Progression

All blocks and turrets have their own research paths:

- Basic blocks: Early-game
- Compressed Xevanon & Mixer: Mid-game
- Tri-Turrets & Ultra-Compressed Xevanon: Late-game

Example: Xevanon Tri-Turret T2 requires 12k Lead, 9k Titanium, 4.5k Thorium, 7.5k Xevanon.

---

## Roadmap

Future updates may include:

- New status effects (e.g., Shock, Burning, Melting)
- Extended tech tree integration
- New planets/sectors for Xevanon resources
- Additional vanilla-compatible turrets

---

## Community & Feedback

- Post issues or ideas on GitHub
- Share screenshots, tips, or videos on Discord / Reddit

---

## License

- MIT License – free to use, modify, and distribute
- Please retain credits for the author

---

## Closing Note

This mod is the result of many hours of testing, balancing, and debugging. Even if there are currently only a few GitHub stars, the project is active and continuously expanding.





## Credits & Acknowledgements

- This mod was created with the help of ChatGPT for design, coding, and balancing guidance.
- Textures for this mod were inspired by and partially created using assets from the Asthosus and Exogenesis mods.
- Some textures were adapted from Mindustry itself.
- This README was also written with the assistance of ChatGPT.

---

## Hinweise & Danksagungen

- Diese Mod wurde mit Hilfe von ChatGPT für Design, Programmierung und Balancing erstellt.
- Texturen für diese Mod wurden inspiriert von und teilweise erstellt mit den Mods Asthosus und Exogenesis.
- Einige Texturen wurden aus dem Spiel Mindustry übernommen.
- Auch diese README wurde mit Unterstützung von ChatGPT erstellt.

name: Mindustry-UnitSpawn
author: Adham084
description:
Spawn any unit in sandbox or in multiplayer, with [stat]/js[] (if supported).
Credits for deltanedas for making Unit Factory.
body:
# Unit Spawn

A simple client-side utility mod for Mindustry that allows spawning units at a selected location through an in-game UI.

## Features

- Spawn any available unit type.
- Select the number of units to spawn.
- Configure spawn position randomness.
- Choose the team for spawned units.
- Pick a spawn location directly from the map.
- Supports both singleplayer and multiplayer environments.

## Usage

1. Open the Unit Spawn button from the HUD.
2. Select a unit type.
3. Choose the amount to spawn.
4. Adjust the randomness radius if desired.
5. Click Set Position and select a location on the map.
6. Choose a team if needed.
7. Press Spawn.

## Multiplayer

In singleplayer, units are spawned directly.

When connected to a server, the mod generates equivalent JavaScript and sends it through "/js" commands. This only works on servers where JavaScript execution is available and where you have sufficient permissions.

Some servers may disable or restrict this functionality.

## Installation

### From GitHub

1. Download the latest release or clone this repository.
2. Place the mod folder inside your Mindustry "mods" directory.
3. Launch Mindustry and enable the mod.

### Mods Directory

#### Windows

```
%AppData%\Mindustry\mods
```

#### Linux

```
~/.local/share/Mindustry/mods
```

#### Android

```
Android/data/io.anuke.mindustry/files/mods
```

## Disclaimer

This mod is intended for sandbox gameplay, testing, map creation, and experimentation.

Always respect server rules when using it in multiplayer.

## Acknowledgement

Credits for deltanedas for making Unit Factory.
